job_location: Hybrid, UK-based, 2 days per week onsite at London office

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Add and maintain tests (dbt + Great Expectations), SLAs and alerting; evolve data contracts in version control and CI.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Responsibilities are dominated by testing, data quality, SLAs, and data contracts with no velocity/speed language present.
evidence.domain_risk: Handle PII with care; partner with Eng/Legal on compliant data use and auditability across pipelines and BI.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: PII handling and auditability are named but there is no financial reporting or regulatory-audit exposure described, placing this at moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: An analytics stack (BigQuery, dbt, Airflow, ThoughtSpot) is already in production use in responsibilities, and the role scales/extends it (own a domain end-to-end, evolve the semantic layer) rather than building from zero, though the Head of Data is still incoming.
evidence.jd_authorship: Design and maintain dbt models (incremental/snapshot), sources, tests, and documentation; enforce naming and folder conventions for scalable analytics.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name precise methodologies (incremental/snapshot models, star/galaxy schemas), specific tools, and concrete milestones, showing exactly what the role does day to day.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: You'll turn warehouse data into trusted, self-serve insights, define core metrics, and ship dashboards that unblock rapid, data-informed decisions across Product, Growth, Partnerships and Ops.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role centers on building the modelling/semantic layer and self-serve analytics infrastructure that the whole business consumes, not one specific commercial, product, or finance function.
evidence.autonomy_level: Own a domain (e.g., revenue or content analytics) end-to-end with a trusted, self-serve dashboard suite.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The six-month milestone grants strategic domain ownership, but near-term work (office hours, dashboard delivery, stakeholder enablement) is execution-oriented, making this mixed.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The JD names Colab/Jupyter notebooks for analysis but does not ask the candidate to use AI coding tools or build AI-consuming infrastructure.
evidence.testing_framing: Add and maintain tests (dbt + Great Expectations), SLAs and alerting; evolve data contracts in version control and CI.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing and data contracts appear as an owned responsibility with action verbs (add, maintain, evolve), not just a tool in a skills list.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Data quality & contracts: Add and maintain tests (dbt + Great Expectations), SLAs and alerting.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Operational reliability (tests, SLAs, alerting, PII/auditability) is a recurring secondary concern but the JD is not framed around regulatory or stakeholder-trust fear, placing it at moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Improve/author at least one Airflow DAG for dbt jobs or backfills; document runbooks.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role both builds new artifacts (semantic layer, metrics catalog, new dashboards) and improves/extends existing pipelines (Airflow DAGs, data contracts), making it mixed.
evidence.work_arrangement: Location: Hybrid, UK-based due to data handling and contractual constraints. 2 days per week onsite at our London office.
evidence.loss_aversion: Handle PII with care; partner with Eng/Legal on compliant data use and auditability across pipelines and BI. Reflects a secondary operational/compliance concern rather than a dominant risk register.
